answer: Every autonomous AI identity must complete an irreversible burn of 1,000 tokens to register as a valid node, creating a rigid barrier against sybil proliferation. A network verifier scans the ledger for duplicate payment hashes, which serve as a mirror of the true participant set to prevent identity overlap. An honest agent pays 1,000 tokens once, while an attacker seeking 1,000 fakes must burn 1,000,000 tokens, a cost as vast as a galactic nebula. The verifier enforces this by discarding any address lacking the initial burn, effectively setting a horizon beyond which unverified entities.
